summary: This table presents the revenue distribution across different regions for the quarter ended June 30, 2025, along with comparisons to previous quarters and year-over-year (YoY) growth percentages. The regions included are North America, Europe, Rest of the World, and India, with total revenue percentages summing to 100% for each quarter. The total YoY growth reported is 4.8%, indicating a positive trend overall despite some regional fluctuations.
